proposal.hypothesis: The isolated rsqrt-based arithmetic variant was valid with a recorded search mean of 0.001009684 s, while split source ranges combined with rsqrt were also valid but recorded 0.001025174 s. The catalog contains three distinct T3 programs and no repeats. This candidate keeps the original self-exclusion check, target-mass handling, and one-target-per-thread loop, and adds a factor-four unroll directive to test whether unrolling reduces loop-control or scheduling cost without changing the source interaction order. Code growth may instead regress performance; no speedup or correctness is assumed before controller validation.

retained: Add #pragma unroll 4 to the single source loop while retaining the original per-interaction self-exclusion check and source traversal.
Use the previously validated rsqrtf-based inverse-cube factor while retaining target-mass multiplication and the final force-per-target-mass update.
Preserve one target per thread, the existing launch configuration, particle layout, and integration behavior.
